content:
Disney+ and Hulu have recently adjusted the monthly fees for most subscription plans. Here are the details of the new pricing.

Disney raises prices for Disney+ and Hulu, with the largest increase for ad-free plans

Disney has once again raised the monthly fees for most of its Disney+ and Hulu streaming services, with the largest increase applied to the ad-free "Premium" plan.

The new prices for ad-free plans take effect immediately as follows:

  • Disney+ Premium (no ads): $21.49 per month
  • Hulu+ Premium (no ads): $21.49 per month
  • Disney+/Hulu Premium bundle: $21.99 per month

Compared with the old prices, this increase is roughly two dollars per month. Disney+ and Hulu Premium were previously $18.99 per month, and the bundle was $19.99 per month.

Ad-supported plans have also gone up this time, just not by as much.

The new prices for ad-supported plans are as follows:

  • Disney+ (with ads): $12.49 per month
  • Hulu (with ads): $12.49 per month

Top-rated comment posted by RDW

I've only been using "free" or promotional streaming services lately. Once the "free" access and promos end, I'm out. These streaming platforms can do whatever they want; it has nothing to do with me.

Disney+ and Hulu were previously $11.99 per month, and this time only went up by $0.50. The Disney+ and Hulu ad-supported bundle has remained unchanged at $12.99.

It's clear Disney is increasingly pushing users toward the Disney+/Hulu bundle. The bundle is only $0.50 more than subscribing separately, making it hard to justify subscribing to just one.

Will this Disney+ price hike affect your subscription? Feel free to share in the comments section.
